text:
Sophie: @Mike we have HelioPay asking for concrete acceptance criteria for the POC — want a clear pass/fail for latency+throughput before procurement signs off.
Mike: ok. baseline ask from them was p95 <200ms, p99 <500ms at ~200 QPS sustained. can we propose something slightly looser to be safe?
Sophie: they also want a cost comparison (reserved vs burst) in the same doc. pricing will be a gating factor.
Jin: i'll prepare the traffic mix: 70% generation (short prompts), 30% embeddings/long prompts. will attach k6 scripts and payloads.
Mike: run notes: we should enable prefix/KV caching + batching size=8 for the POC to reflect production config. pre-warm cache for 10m.
Tara: security needs: whitelist IPs for load agents, SOC2 docs, KMS integration details and data residency statement before we run.
Sophie: HelioPay's SQ calls out KMS + purge policy + audit logs. i've drafted answers but need ops to confirm wording.
Mike: proposed runbook:
1) smoke: 10 QPS x 2m
2) ramp: 10 -> 200 QPS over 10m
3) steady: 200 QPS x 30m
4) 2x burst: 400 QPS x 1m (validate graceful degradation)
Command we plan to use:
```
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 30m helio_mix.js
```
Sophie: metrics to capture: p50/p95/p99 latency, success rate, tokens/sec, GPU util, KV hit rate, 5xx rate. also snapshot model version.
Mike: quick dev-cluster run (informational): p95=140ms, p99=320ms @120 QPS, ~110 req/s throughput, GPU util ~48% (single A100-equivalent). dev != prod but helps set expectations.
Tara: heads-up: production tail usually worse — we'll set SLO-style alerts: 5xx > 0.5% and p99 > 600ms triggers investigation.
Sophie: customer asked about model drift during test — we'll explicitly pin model version and snapshot caches; note that quantization/variants must match prod variant.
Jin: uploading k6 scripts + sample payloads to the POC bucket now, will share link in thread.
Sophie: pricing ask from HelioPay: 'if we go reserved for this workload, what monthly commitment vs on-demand for bursts?' ops, ballpark please.
Mike: ballpark numbers: reserved pool sized for 200 QPS ~ $18k/mo; adding burst capacity for occasional 400 QPS windows ~ +$3.5k/mo in blended cost. exact calc after we finalize avg token lengths.
Sophie: proposed acceptance criteria to present to customer:
- Sustained 200 QPS for 30m, success rate >= 99.5%
- p95 < 250ms, p99 < 600ms
- No unplanned 5xx during steady window (planned failovers documented)
If they sign this, we schedule Wed or Thu next week.
Tara: +1 to criteria. security checklist must be cleared before the test window. @Sophie can you confirm they will provide the test IP CIDRs and sign the test consent?
Sophie: i'll ping them now and attach the draft acceptance doc.
DeployBot: SOC2 report and Uptime SLA uploaded: /shared/poc/helio/ (links posted) :white_check_mark:
Sophie: thanks. once I have IPs and sign-off i'll lock a 2hr window and post the exact timestamps. appreciate the quick turnaround, team. :thumbsup:
